step0_classification.evidence: thirteen host/device nodes carry fourteen relations whose whole content is addresses and qualifiers (bond0 192.168.1.197 on 192.168.1.0/24, tailscale0 100.113.153.49, ONT 169.254.3.1 as a historical reading, AS701/AS13335, ULA-only v6): E is about N, the traceroute tail is deep, and coverage of identifiers and qualifiers is the hard part, not geometry.
tie_breakers_considered: Density: 14 relations over 13 nodes, so E is about N and the shape is not a mesh or a fabric (rules out service-meshes and redundant-fabrics).

Bus with disconnected worlds: the virtual nets, the overlay and the egress path are three weakly-connected worlds, but they meet at one host hub, not at a source-named shared bus, so placement-planes is not the dominant family (no trunk to draw).

Identifier content outranks shape: every node label is an address or a device identity and the source spends two sections on qualifications (historical ONT/router identity, ULA-only v6), which is the identity-probe-map signature the skill itself lists for this case.
Motion: the source never animates anything (historical observations only), so no dot is drawn anywhere; the lifecycle/fabric motion habits do not apply.
step0_classification.secondary_recipe_applied: placement-planes, borrowed spatially: each weakly-connected world keeps its own side-by-side area by living in its own view (v1 physical LAN + gateway, v2 egress/WAN, v3 virtual + overlay), with the host and the router repeated at the junction so the reader can stitch the worlds without a drawn border.

group_hue_check.engine_note: the family is chosen from the SET of declared group names, so a hue can only drift when two names collide in a view. This is a mitigation, not a renderer fix; the renderer behaviour is unchanged.

blockers.blocker: viz-evidence.sh cannot type into a fresh pane in this environment
blockers.detail: a new Herdr pane's interactive shell needs 5.8-15.2 s to print its first prompt (oh-my-zsh + nvm + bun in ~/.zshrc); the script types ~0.2 s after the split and its wait-output matches the echoed command line, so the first capture read only sees the typed command and manifest.viewport_token/viewport_line stay null. Measured with `herdr pane read` polling after each split.
blockers.workaround_used: the script was run with the caller's cwd set to /tmp (it passes --cwd "$(pwd)" to the split), where direnv/git prompt work does not run and the pane shell is ready in ~1.2 s; all three bundles then captured the drawn app. The script itself was not modified.
blockers.residual_effect: manifest.pane_rect/pane_cols are null because `herdr pane layout` inside the script resolves to the focused tab (a different workspace), not this tab; pane_rows came from `pane get` viewport_rows. Fit is therefore proven by the app's own header token plus the pinned 77x47 dumps, per the pinned ruling.
